verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation of Google Drive's desktop client, selective sync, or on-demand file streaming — all cited docs are API/developer references. The only relevant signal is community feedback describing the desktop sync client as 'quite unreliable' on Mac, with 'synced' files sometimes being placeholder URLs rather than real content, which speaks to (partially working) online-only file behavior but with real reliability caveats. missing for 10: official desktop client docs, cross-platform (macOS/Windows) parity details, selective sync configuration, on-demand/online-only file documentation, and independent corroboration beyond one critical community report.
